name: Southbreak Shore
summary: Southbreak Shore is a wide, sun-bleached expanse of sandy coastline stretching along the southeastern edge of Tanaris. Bordering the pirate haven of Lost Rigger Cove, its sands are dominated by roving buccaneers, scavenging shore crabs, and wandering sea giants.

sections.title: A Lawless Strand
sections.body: Southbreak Shore forms the southern boundary of the Southsea Freebooters' operations in Tanaris. While the deeper harbor of Lost Rigger Cove shelters their main fleet and encampments, Southbreak Shore serves as an open flank where Captain Dreadbeard organizes his crews along the surf. The strand is far from empty, crawling with Duneshore Crabs and massive sea giants that roam out of the tides, seemingly cooperating with Dreadbeard's brigands through unknown means.

sections.title: The Offshore Isle
sections.body: Just beyond the breaking waves sits a tiny, isolated spit of sand. Inhabiting this lonely offshore islet is a solitary gnome named Winkey, who watches the coastline in complete quiet. Why she has chosen to make camp mere swimming distance from bloodthirsty pirates and hulking giants remains an enigma to travelers passing along the desert coast.

faq.answer: Southbreak Shore is located along the far southeastern coast of Tanaris, situated immediately south of Lost Rigger Cove and east of the deep desert dunes.
The northern reaches of the beach are overrun by the Southsea Freebooters under the direct command of Captain Dreadbeard, while the rest is prowled by wild creatures and towering sea giants.

faq.q: Who is Winkey and why is she on the island?
faq.answer: Winkey is a lone gnome who lives on a tiny offshore islet just past the surf. She offers no official tasks or explanation for her presence so close to hostile pirates and ocean hazards.

faq.q: Why are there sea giants along the beach?
aliases: why are sea giants helping pirates
faq.answer: Sea giants patrol the shallow tides along Southbreak Shore and appear to be aiding Captain Dreadbeard and his pirates, though exactly how the freebooters secured the loyalty or cooperation of these behemoths is unknown.

angles.text: The presence of Winkey standing alone on a secluded spit of sand off this perilous coast is a peculiar sight that naturally draws the curiosity of passing gnomes.
The Southsea buccaneers scouring Southbreak Shore are ruthless competitors in maritime plunder, making their outposts prime territory for reconnaissance and opportunistic thievery.
